mapper.sql: select cry_id, baby_id, start_time, end_time, intensity, possible_cause, soothe_methods, soothe_effect, notes, operator_id, operator_name, rev, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_by_name, update_time, remark from nc_cry
mapper.select: select extract(hour from start_time)::int::varchar as label, count(*)::int as count from nc_cry where baby_id = #{babyId} and del_flag = '0' and start_time::date >= current_date - (#{days}::int - 1) group by extract(hour from start_time)::int order by extract(hour from start_time)::int

select trim(method) as label, count(*)::int as count, sum(case when c.soothe_effect = 'effective' then 1 else 0 end)::int as extra from nc_cry c cross join unnest(string_to_array(c.soothe_methods, ',')) as method where c.baby_id = #{babyId} and c.del_flag = '0' and c.start_time::date >= current_date - (#{days}::int - 1) and c.soothe_methods is not null and c.soothe_methods <> '' and trim(method) <> '' group by trim(method) order by extra desc, count desc
mapper.update: update nc_cry set start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, intensity = #{intensity}, possible_cause = #{possibleCause}, soothe_methods = #{sootheMethods}, soothe_effect = #{sootheEffect}, notes = #{notes}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_by_name = #{updateByName}, rev = rev + 1, update_time = current_timestamp where cry_id = #{cryId} and del_flag = '0' and rev = #{rev}
